interface.longDescription: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. One server for data center and energy intelligence: facilities, colocation, power and grid, interconnection queues, electricity and gas prices, fiber and site selection. Every answer is dated and cited. Includes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), a daily score of where data centers can get grid power. Start with execute_plan. Read-only; no account needed to start.
capabilities: Rank data-center markets by power availability
Read live US grid conditions and interconnection queues
Check site hazard, water and fiber
Look up data-center deals and news
defaultPrompt: How soon can a 100 MW data center get grid power in ERCOT?
Compare Phoenix and Dallas for a 50 MW data center: power, grid and DCPI verdict.
Search DC Hub for data centers in Ashburn, Virginia.

positive.description: Live grid and time to power
positive.prompt: What is the live grid situation and time to power in ERCOT for a 200 MW data center?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live ERCOT demand and fuel mix, score bands, interconnection queue depth and a time-to-power estimate, with an as-of date and a citation line.

positive.prompt: Rank the top 5 US data-center markets by DCPI verdict and show time to power.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns five ranked markets, each with a BUILD, CAUTION or AVOID verdict, a score band and time to power, with an as-of date.

positive.prompt: Find operational data centers in Ashburn, Virginia over 50 MW.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching facilities with operator, capacity, status and a citable DC Hub URL. Capacity figures not available on the free tier are marked as withheld, not guessed.

positive.prompt: What are the hazard, water and fiber conditions at 33.45, -112.07 for a data center?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns hazard ratings for the location, a water-stress reading, and the nearest carrier-served facility with its carrier count, each with its source.

positive.prompt: Show recent hyperscaler data-center deals and the M&A transactions this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent deals with buyer, seller, date, and amount and MW where stated, with citations.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function to reverse a linked list.
